affinity.subtitle: Automatically place the game on the best cores and other apps on a different set of cores.
affinity.antiCheatBody: Some anti-cheat software (for example Vanguard, EasyAntiCheat (EAC) or BattlEye) may warn about or block changes to a process's affinity. This tool never touches protected or system processes and skips (and logs) any process it cannot open, but it cannot guarantee compatibility with anti-cheat software. Check the rules of the game before using it in online matches, and use it at your own risk.
affinity.enable: Apply automatically when a game starts
affinity.enableDesc: When on, the affinity is optimized only while a registered game is running and is restored when it exits. While off, nothing runs at all.

state.idleDesc: Waiting for a registered game to start. A lightweight check runs every 2 seconds; the settings are applied automatically at launch and restored at exit.

wizard.title: Welcome — please read before you start
wizard.disclaimerBody:
This software is provided free of charge under the MIT License, AS IS, without warranty of any kind.

• It changes registry values. The effect depends on your Windows build and hardware and may be zero.
• The previous values are backed up automatically and can be restored from this app, but a complete restore in every situation cannot be guaranteed. Back up important data and consider creating a system restore point first.
• Some anti-cheat software (for example Vanguard or EAC) may warn about or block changes to process or system settings. Follow the terms of your games and use this tool at your own risk.
• The author is not liable for any damage resulting from the use of this software.
• The tool never touches security features (Defender, UAC, Windows Update, firewall, and so on). It makes no network connections and has no telemetry.

See DISCLAIMER.md for details.
wizard.agree: I have read and understood the above and accept the risk.
wizard.restoreBody: A restore point lets you roll Windows back even if something unexpected happens. Windows may skip creating a new one if one was made within the last 24 hours, and System Protection must be turned on.
wizard.restoreFailed: The restore point could not be created.
wizard.restoreDemo: Demo mode: no restore point is created.
wizard.presetBody: If you want a starting point, the Safe preset is the most conservative option. Nothing is applied now: you will see the exact differences first and can still cancel. The effect depends on your Windows build and may be nil.

affinity.subtitle: Automatically place the game and background processes on suitable CPU cores.
affinity.desc: Planned (milestone 5): CPU topology detection, game profiles, automatic apply/restore. Note: some anti-cheat software may warn about or block affinity changes. The benefit is small on simple CPU layouts.

usb.desc: Planned (milestone 6): uses the documented Windows power-setting API only, with the previous values backed up.
